FAQ.title: Frequently Asked
FAQ.q0: Is the Penya a for-profit business?
FAQ.a0: NO! Penya Blaugrana San Diego is a 100% non-profit organization. We do not profit from membership dues or merchandise. Every dollar collected goes directly toward operational costs (website, events, hosting) and our charitable initiatives in the San Diego community.
FAQ.q1: Do I need to be a member to watch games?
FAQ.a1: No! Everyone is welcome to watch matches with us at Novo Brazil Brewing. Membership is optional but supports the Penya and gets you exclusive merch and perks.
FAQ.q2: Are kids allowed at the watch parties?
FAQ.a2: Absolutely. Novo Brazil Otay Ranch is a family-friendly venue. We have many members who bring their children to enjoy the matches.
FAQ.q3: What are the benefits of membership?
FAQ.a3:
Becoming a Penyista is more than just joining a club; it is your official connection to FC Barcelona. As a recognized member, you receive:

Official Recognition: Direct connection to the FC Barcelona Confederation of Penyes worldwide.Match Access: Priority access to tickets for home matches at Camp Nou, away games, Clásicos, and Champions League fixtures.Exclusive Events: Invitations to private watch parties, community service events, and international Penya gatherings.Travel Experiences: Organized group trips to Barcelona and opportunities for behind-the-scenes visits (Museum, Training Facilities).Merch & Perks: Access to official Penya merchandise, special scarves/pins, and discounts with local partners.
FAQ.q4: How do I pick up my membership merch?
FAQ.a4: Merch is available for pickup at any matchday event. Just find a board member (look for the people checking in members), show your confirmation email, and we'll get you sorted!
FAQ.q5: How do I register for my official FC Barcelona Penyista card?
FAQ.a5: As a member of our Penya, you are eligible for official recognition by the club in Barcelona. To receive your physical 'Carnet de Penyista' (Penyista ID), you must register your profile on the official FC Barcelona supporters portal at <link>penyes.fcbarcelona.com</link>.
